fusions.name: Dust Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks up a clod that deals 4 damage, up to 1.8 times as much at its maximum range, with a 30% chance of [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Cached Bone
fusions.desc: Primes up to 3 bodies in reach. Each bursts for 30 damage to enemies within 3.5 tiles the moment an enemy comes near it.

fusions.name: Round Them Up
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 6 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Gleaned Scraps
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 8 stamina and 2 health. Once every 6 seconds.
